value.rationale: A complete answer for all linear Rota–Baxter operators, not merely diagonal ones, on a natural simple perfect two-dimensional example singled out by the recent perfect-algebra open problem. The unique weight-zero resonance in characteristic 31 has an intrinsic discriminant explanation, while the nonzero-weight classification is controlled by ordered pairs of rational roots of a cubic and varies across finite fields. This nontrivial arithmetic boundary motivates studying parameter-dependent families of simple perfect evolution algebras.
